description: This PHP class 'PageSettings' parses XML data related to spreadsheet page setup options such as margins, orientation, paper size, and print order, and applies these settings to a Spreadsheet object's active sheet.

classes.name: PageSettings
classes.description: Handles parsing of XML configuration for spreadsheet page setup and applies the settings to a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes page settings by parsing XML and setting print configurations.

methods.name: loadPageSettings
methods.description: Applies parsed page setup and margin settings to the active sheet of a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: pageSetup
methods.description: Parses XML to extract page setup options such as layout, margins, and print settings.

methods.name: printSetup
methods.description: Parses XML for print-specific options like scale and paper size.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Configures page layout options such as orientation and centered margins.

methods.name: setMargins
methods.description: Sets the page margin configurations based on XML attributes.
